annotation.title_clean: SB226 Enrolled: An Act relating to motor vehicles; requirements for the authorization and use of motor vehicles equipped with an automated driving system
annotation.title_en: Alabama SB226 Enrolled Act: Automated Driving System-Equipped Motor Vehicles
annotation.summary_en: Enrolled Alabama act authorizing operation of automated driving system-equipped vehicles on public roads, including driverless operation if a minimal risk condition is achievable. It sets insurance minimums, crash-response duties, treats the ADS as operator, preempts local regulation, and permits on-demand autonomous vehicle networks. Effective October 1, 2024.
key_provisions_or_claims: Driverless ADS vehicles may operate if they comply with traffic laws and FMVSS and can achieve a minimal risk condition
Fully autonomous vehicles require proof of at least $100,000 liability coverage; commercial driverless operators must carry $1,000,000 per accident
ADS is deemed the operator when engaged and solely responsible for driving
State preempts local entities from regulating or taxing ADS vehicle operation
On-demand autonomous vehicle networks allowed under TNC laws; effective October 1, 2024
